lead.en: Explain host-provided prompt cache outcomes and request costs.
lead.zh: 解释宿主提供的提示缓存结果与请求费用。

signature: (u64, Result<(CacheResult, CacheState, u64, Option<u64>), SharedString>, &mut Context<Self>)

rule.en: The host supplies outcomes, token counts, costs, latency and cache lifetime. Requests require matching IDs; failures preserve prior results and stale responses are ignored. Simulated values must be labelled.
rule.zh: 结果、token 数、费用、耗时和缓存期限由宿主提供；请求需匹配 ID，失败时保留已有结果并忽略过期响应。模拟数值必须明确标注。

api.en: Next request emits PromptCacheAction; resolve supplies the result or error. An optional changed segment can be armed before sending.
api.zh: 下一次请求发出 PromptCacheAction，宿主用 resolve 返回结果或错误；发送前可选择性标记变更的前缀段。

motion.en: Confirmed result bars transition into view. The reference's automatic playback, cache-flight and countdown animation are not yet implemented; visual and accessibility validation remain pending.
motion.zh: 确认后的结果条平滑显示；参考站的自动播放、缓存飞行和倒计时动画尚未实现，视觉和无障碍验收仍待完成。
